attributes.name: Shrunken Head
attributes.powers:
Discard this card to ignore a monster's powers that happen before you act, then add the monster's adventure deck number to your checks to defeat it.

After playing this card, you may succeed at a Perception 9 check to recharge this card instead of discarding it.
